glosses: crossing, intersection (where roads, lines, or tracks cross)
crossroads, crossing, intersection (a place where one road crosses another; an intersection of two or more roads)

examples.en: The accident happened at that intersection.
There was an accident at the intersection.

examples.text: Meu carro morreu no meio do cruzamento.
examples.en: My car stalled in the middle of the intersection.

examples.text: Vire à direita no próximo cruzamento.
examples.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

examples.text: Você deve ter mais cuidado em um cruzamento.
examples.en: You should be more careful at a crosswalk.
